<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex071012025-12-0115-13-47" status="unreviewed">
				de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3747">rgyal ba byams pa</rs> 'di nyid kyi zhal nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3756">slob dpon thogs med</rs> la gsungs so || 
				des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3758">dbyig gnyen</rs> la | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3708">'phags pa rnam grol sde</rs> la | des <rs type="person">so so skye bo rnam grol sde</rs> la | des <rs type="person">mchog gi <lb n="1b3"/>sde</rs> la | des <rs type="person">'dul ba'i sde</rs> la | des <rs type="person">rnam par snang mdzad bzang po</rs> la | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng ge bzang po</rs> la | des <rs type="person">'gu na b+ha dra</rs> la | des <rs type="person">rad na b+ha dra</rs> la | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6840">gser gling pa</rs> la | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo rje</rs> la gsungs so || 
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo rje</rs> la pha rol du phyin pa'i gdams pa manga' yang | phyin ci ma log par thob pa ni <rs type="person">'khams kyi ja dar ston pa</rs> dang | <rs type="person">ldang <lb n="1b4"/> chang ston pa</rs>'o || 
				de la bshad pa dang sgom pa'i gdams pa de gnyis ka <rs type="person">dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'khams pa</rs>s gsan no || 
				de la <rs type="person">slob dpon</rs> gyis grags pa dang nyed pa la ma ltos par gsan no | de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag cag</rs> rang gis thos pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
